utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Morning, everyone. Monday the twenty-sixth. Can you all hear me, or am I talking to myself again?

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yeah, you're coming through. Unlike the heating in the portakabin. I've still got my coat on. Just moaning, not raising a job.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: That's your winter office package. Desk, chair, mild hypothermia.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Well, there's a birthday cake in the office, if that's any consolation.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Depends. Proper cake or one of those healthy ones?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Proper cake. Right, before we lose the entire meeting to that, what's already cleared?

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: I've signed off the inspection on the line 3 screw on Tuesday. That's last Tuesday, all done.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Yeah, that was still showing in the old notes, wasn't it?

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: It was. And I already swapped the filter on the line one HPU yesterday. That's finished as well, not another filter job for today.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Lovely. Both historical, then.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Only other thing from nights: noticed the Forklift Fleet was running a bit warm on nights but it settled down.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Settled back to normal, you mean? Not still creeping up?

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah, normal again. Just an observation from the shift, nothing ongoing being raised here.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: And I'm still waiting on parts for the line 3 chiller, nothing we can do until they arrive.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yeah, still outstanding. No arrival to report, unfortunately.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, that stays blocked. Not putting work against it today.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Jamie Brennan, can you send the shift handover report round by 11am? Normal priority.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: The shift handover report, yeah? Not the older weekly one?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: That's it, the shift handover report. By 11am, normal priority.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yep, I'll send it round by 11am.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Cheers, Jamie Brennan.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Callum, can you run the monthly fire alarm test after lunch? Normal priority on that.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah. Monthly test rather than an evacuation exercise, just so we're saying the same thing?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Exactly, just the monthly fire alarm test.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Fine, I'll run it after lunch. Normal priority.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Sorry, did someone else speak then? Teams did that underwater noise.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Only me. Apparently my finest radio voice isn't getting through.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Um, I'll do a site visit at the water works with the contractor today. That's a whenever-you-get-a-chance one, isn't it?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yes, Grace. Today, but whenever you get a chance. No need to put it ahead of the urgent stuff.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Yep, I'll take that one.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: And I'll update the risk assessment for work on the boiler feed pump. I'll drop everything for that one.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Agreed, Grace. That's the one that takes precedence.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Yeah, the visit is flexible. The risk assessment isn't something I'm leaving behind the routine bits.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Understood. Different urgency, even if they're next to each other in the notes.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: I'll swap the filter on the air dryer today as well. Low priority, that one.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: The filter itself, yeah? Not rolling the sensor calibration into that?

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Yeah, just the filter on the air dryer today. Low priority. Separate job.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Got it, Aisha.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: For the other one, I'll recalibrate the sensors on the Compressed Air Dryer on the 3rd. No rush on that.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Right, so that calibration isn't part of today's filter swap. That's where I was getting muddled.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Exactly. Compressed Air Dryer sensors on the 3rd, no rush.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks, Aisha. Keeping those separate.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Aisha, can you investigate the pressure drop on the turbine two water valve first thing tomorrow? That's holding production up so it needs doing first.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll investigate it first thing tomorrow. Ahead of the other work.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah, that's the production hold-up, not the filter. Sorry, talking over you there.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: No, worth being clear. The turbine two water valve needs doing first tomorrow because it's holding production up.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Understood. First thing tomorrow, that gets first place.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: And I'll sort the permit to work and isolation for the Main Outfeed Conveyor by Wednesday.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Sarah, that's both the permit to work and the isolation you're taking?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yep, both. I'll sort the permit to work and isolation for the Main Outfeed Conveyor by Wednesday.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Okay, clear. Not just the paperwork half.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Tom, can you organise the toolbox talk for the team tomorrow at 9:30? Not an emergency but don't let it slip.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Yeah, sorry, was that nine or half nine? It clipped.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Tomorrow at 9:30. Half nine, Tom.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Got you. I'll organise the toolbox talk for the team tomorrow at 9:30. Not an emergency, but I won't let it slip.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Teams has only eaten the important syllables this morning.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Very selective. Heard every word about cake.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right. Anything we've crossed wires on?

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: No, all clear now. Audio's behaving again as well.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Yeah, same here. I think two microphones were fighting each other earlier.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Most productive fight in this portakabin. Is the cake chocolate, by the way?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: It is. And no, that isn't going in the actions.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Good. We'd only argue about the priority.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: We absolutely would. Right, thanks everyone. That's us.
